newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daikyo appoints new president from Sanwa Bank unit.
newsitem.headline: Daikyo appoints new president from Sanwa Bank unit.

text.p: Daikyo Inc, a Japanese condominium developer, said on Friday that it would appoint Masaharu Hasegawa, president of a finance unit of Sanwa Bank Ltd, as Daikyo's new president.

Hasegawa, who currently heads Sanwa Business Credit Co Ltd and has served as a vice president of Sanwa Bank in the past, will replace Shuji Yokoyama at the helm of the troubled Daikyo, which has accumulated massive debts in the wake of plunging land prices.
Sanwa Bank is Daikyo's main bank. Media reports earlier said that Daikyo hopes Sanwa Bank will aid in the company's restructuring.
